description: The James Webb Space Telescope has produced the first 3D map of Uranus’s upper atmosphere, tracking temperatures and ion densities up to 5,000 kilometers above its clouds. The observations reveal bright auroras shaped by the planet’s tilted magnetic field and confirm that Uranus is still slowly cooling over long timescales.
title: James Webb Telescope Maps Uranus in 3D for the First Time; Data Reveals Hidden Storms, Methane Clouds

description: One of the most anticipated Tamil crime-thriller films, Ram Abdullah Antony, has finally made its way to digital screens. The film centers on three 12th-grade friends—Ram, Abdullah, and Antony—who belong to different religions but are inseparable. This film is now available for rent exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.
title: Ram Abdullah Antony Streaming on Prime Video: What to Know About Poovaiyar, Soundararaja Starrer

description: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 series, which includes the Galaxy Buds 4 Pro and Galaxy Buds 4, has been launched as the flagship addition to the South Korean tech giant’s true wireless stereo (TWS) lineup. The new Galaxy Buds 4 were unveiled at Samsung’s Galaxy Unpacked 2026 event along with the Galaxy S26 Ultra, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26. The two models are set to go on sale in select global markets soon. While the Pro model is offered in Black, White, and Pink colour options, the standard model will be available for purchase in Black and White colourways. The Galaxy Buds 4 series ships with adaptive active noise cancellation (ANC) support.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro Launched in India With Adaptive ANC, Head Gesture Support; Galaxy Buds 4 Tags Along: Price, Specs

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+ have been launched in global markets, including India. The new Galaxy S series smartphones run on the Exynos 2600 chipset and feature triple rear camera units. The standard Galaxy S26 has a 4,300mAh battery, while the Galaxy S26+ has a 4,900mAh battery. They run on Android 16 with Samsung's One UI 8.5 on top.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+ Launched in India With 2nm Exynos 2600 Chip, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2026 is here, which means I got new S-series devices to check out, and I will start with the Ultra, of course. While the world may have already seen the Galaxy S26 Ultra thanks to a leak mere days before the actual launch. But there are tons of details that aren't covered well, so let me dive straight into it.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra First Impressions

description: Samsung launched the Galaxy S26 Ultra alongside the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+ on Thursday. The flagship features a 6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with Privacy Display support, a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a 200-megapixel quad rear camera system. It runs One UI 8.5 based on Android 16 with new Galaxy AI features. The phone supports 5G connectivity and packs a 5,000mAh battery with 60W fast charging in a slimmer Ultra design.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Launched in India With Privacy Display Feature, 200-Megapixel Main Camera: Price, Features

description: Prakambanam, now streaming on ZEE5, is a Malayalam comedy-drama that blends hostel life chaos with a spooky ritual twist. Featuring Ganapathi, Sagar Surya, and Al Ameen in lead roles, the film balances humor and seriousness while exploring themes of friendship, rivalry, and family beliefs.
title: Prakambanam OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Ganapathi and Sagar Surya Starrer Online?

description: Directed by Ajay Bhuyan, Psych Saiyaan is a recently released romance thriller web series that has finally reached the audience. The plot of the series centres around a young poet whose love turns into a dark obsession when he begins to chase her love interest across cities. Also, the plot takes a thrilling turn when a ruthless gangster enters their lives. The series is currently streaming on Prime Video (MX Player) with six episodes.
title: Psycho Saiyaan Now Available for Streaming Online: Where to Watch Tejasswi Prakash’s Digital Debut?

description: With Resident Evil Requiem, Capcom seems to have written the next chapter in the story of the horror genre in video games. The developer has managed to craft an experience that rarely misses a beat; that takes ambitious, risky swings and sticks the landing.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Review: Capcom's Horror Masterpiece Bridges Fear and Thrill

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 series is tipped to support file sharing with Apple’s AirDrop. This feature is said to work through Samsung’s Quick Share. It is expected to roll out to older Galaxy devices as part of the One UI 8.5 update. The recipient has to set AirDrop to "Everyone" to initiate the transfer of files from the Samsung Galaxy smartphone. To receive the files, Samsung users need to tap the Quick Share in the quick panel.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Tipped to Support AirDrop Compatibility via Quick Share

description: OnePlus is reportedly planning multiple product launches in the coming weeks, including the OnePlus Nord 6, OnePlus 15s, a premium tablet, Buds Pro 4 earbuds and a budget smartphone, according to a tipster leak. The first wave is expected between late March and early April. The Nord 6 could feature a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset and 80W charging, while the OnePlus 15s may arrive as a rebadged OnePlus 15T. However, OnePlus has not officially confirmed the lineup or launch timeline.
title: OnePlus Nord 6, OnePlus 15s, Buds Pro 4 and Other Products Tipped to Launch This Year

description: Secret Stories: Roslin, directed by Sumesh Nandakumar and showrun by Jeethu Joseph, is an intense Malayalam psychological thriller streaming from February 27, 2026. With a gripping plot, multilingual release, and strong performances, the series aims to deliver a suspenseful and emotionally layered OTT experience.
title: Secret Stories: Roslin Streams on JioHotstar From February 27: What You Need to Know

description: Realme GT 9 series is expected to go official later this year. A new leak suggests that the Realme GT 9 will feature a 200-megapixel rear camera. The Realme GT 9 Pro is tipped to feature dual 200-megapixel sensors. This would be a notable upgrade over the existing Realme GT 8 series. Realme GT 8 does not include a 200-megapixel sensor. The Realme GT 8 Pro, in contrast, has a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera with up to 120x digital zoom.
title: Realme GT 9 Pro Tipped to Feature Dual 200-Megapixel Rear Camera Setup

description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) announced a new national-level initiative on Wednesday. It is intended to promote the use of blockchain technology in various sectors. The initiative has been named “Blockchain India Challenge.” This is a move towards developing indigenous blockchain solutions. MeitY stated that they are looking to identify high-impact use cases and develop scalable, secure, and interoperable blockchain applications.
title: MeitY Launches Blockchain India Challenge, Invites Startups to Solve Governance Problems

description: Nothing has confirmed that the upcoming Phone 4a model will be available in a Pink colourway, alongside the previously teased white option. The new finish marks the first time the company has introduced a pink variant across its smartphone portfolio. The UK-based OEM said the colour reflects a more expressive design direction influenced by art, fashion and pop culture.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Confirmed to Launch in a Pink Colourway Ahead of March 5 Launch

description: Infinix Note Edge 5G is now available for purchase in India via Flipkart. The handset was launched in the country earlier this month. The handset is currently on sale in Lunar Titanium, Silk Green, and Stellar Blue colour options. Moreover, it is offered in 6GB + 128GB, 8GB + 128GB, and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The new phone is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset, paired with a Mali-G610 GPU. It sports a 6.78-inch 1.5K (1,208x2,644 pixels) LTPS 3D curved AMOLED display.
title: Infinix Note Edge 5G With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Oppo Find N6 has surfaced in multiple leaks suggesting upgrades to its hinge and display technology. A tipster claims the foldable was recognised by TÜV Rheinland as the flattest tested device, reportedly using a titanium alloy hinge and self healing glass. A leaked X video also shows a near zero crease inner display. The phone is expected to feature large dual displays, a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, a 6,000mAh battery and a high resolution multi camera setup.
title: Oppo Find N6 Leak Indicates It Could Sport a Crease-Free Foldable Screen

description: Realme C83 5G will be launched in India on March 7 at 12 pm local time, the Chinese smartphone maker revealed on Wednesday. A dedicated microsite for the handset has been made live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. Moreover, the key specifications and features of the upcoming phone have been revealed by the company, including its battery capacity, design, colour options, and display. This comes soon after the pricing of the handset in India surfaced online, along with the RAM and storage configurations.
title: Realme C83 5G India Launch Date Announced; Company Reveals Availability, Key Specifications

description: Vivo V70 FE is expected to be launched soon. Although Vivo has yet to confirm the launch of a new Vivo smartphone, it was spotted on the Google Play supported devices list. It has reportedly spotted on the Google Play Console with an official-looking image. It is said to come with a MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Turbo chipset and a 7,000mAh battery. It is expected to launch on February 28 in three colour options. It could feature a dual rear camera unit including a 200-megapixel main sensor.
title: Vivo V70 FE Launch Seems Imminent as Handset Lands on Google Play Console, Google Play Supported Devices List

description: YouTube announced the addition of two new features to the YouTube Premium Lite plan in India and the global markets. As per the video streaming platform, subscribers will soon be eligible to use background play and offline downloads — two of the most requested features missing from the lower-cost tier. YouTube said that changes aim to make Premium Lite a more complete alternative for users who want fewer ads and playback controls, without paying for the full YouTube Premium subscription.
title: YouTube Premium Lite Subscription Gains Background Playback, Offline Downloads: Price, Benefits

description: The iPhone 18 series is rumoured to be unveiled at Apple's September event, headlined by the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. According to a report, both purported handsets could feature several quality-of-life upgrades, including a redesigned Dynamic Island. The Cupertino-based tech giant will reportedly equip the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max with a smaller notch compared to the current iPhone 17 Pro lineup.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro to Feature Redesigned Dynamic Island With Smaller Notch: Report

description: Apple will launch the new MacBook Pro models with OLED touchscreens in the fall of this year, according to a Bloomberg report. The Cupertino-based tech giant was earlier expected to unveil its first touchscreen laptop in early 2027. This is part of the iPhone-maker’s attempts to bridge the gap between its tablets and laptops. The rumoured MacBook Pro model with an OLED touchscreen will reportedly be powered by Apple’s M6 processor. Moreover, the tech giant could also bring the Dynamic Island feature to the laptop to remove the notch, which is found on the MacBook Air and Pro models.
title: MacBook Pro With OLED Touchscreen, Dynamic Island Said to Launch Earlier Than Expected

description: Sony and Insomniac Games have finally confirmed the launch date for Marvel's Wolverine. The superhero action-adventure title will release exclusively on PS5 on September 15. Wolverine will release over two months before GTA 6, giving it ample breathing room ahead of Rockstar's juggernaut release.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Will Launch on September 15, 2026, Insomniac Games Confirms

description: OnePlus 16 will be launched with less than 1mm-thick bezels on the front, a tipster claims. It is said to be the only flagship smartphone this year that will sport such thin bezels around the display. Moreover, the leaker claims that the Chinese smartphone maker will equip the OnePlus 16 with a built-in active cooling fan to control the temperatures and capacitive shoulder triggers for gaming. However, the company has yet to confirm these details. If this turns out to be true, it would be a significant improvement over the 1.15mm-thick bezels on the OnePlus 15.
title: OnePlus 16 to Sport Significantly Thinner Bezels Than OnePlus 15, Won't Feature Active Cooling, Tipster Claims

description: Alleged renders of the Oppo Find N6 have emerged online, showing its design. The renders show the phone in two colours with a circular-shaped rear camera module. The LED flash is positioned outside the camera module, indicating a slight design change from last year's Find N5. Everything else appears unchanged from the Find N5. The Oppo Find N6 is rumoured to come with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset alongside up to 16GB RAM and up to 1TB storage.
title: Oppo Find N6 Leaked Images Hint at Two Colourways; Minor Design Updates Expected

description: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked LIVE Updates: Samsung’s first launch event of 2026 is just hours away, with expectations centred on new Galaxy AI‑powered smartphones and TWS earbuds. The flagship Galaxy S26 lineup will likely include three models. Samsung is also anticipated to reveal the Galaxy Buds 4 and Buds 4 Pro during its first in‑person launch of the year, streamed across its official platforms.
title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2026 LIVE: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series, Galaxy Buds 4 Lineup Launch Expected

description: Samsung is said to have hiked the price of several Galaxy A and Galaxy F series models in India. A leaked internal document appears to detail revised pricing across multiple models in the company’s budget and mid-range portfolio. While the company has not officially announced any changes, the leak indicates that the updated prices may already be effective across retail and online channels.
title: Samsung Reportedly Hikes Prices for Galaxy A56 5G, A36 5G, and F17 5G in India; New Rates Inside

description: Xiaomi may unveil HyperOS 3.1 at Mobile World Congress 2026, according to a new report. The update is rumoured to introduce an iOS Bridge feature designed to improve connectivity between Xiaomi devices and Apple products. Expected features include iPhone call notifications on Xiaomi devices, improved AirPods integration and direct wireless file sharing between platforms. The update could debut alongside the Xiaomi 17 series. However, Xiaomi has not officially confirmed HyperOS 3.1 or the reported features so far.
title: Xiaomi HyperOS 3.1 Leak Reveals iOS Bridge Feature With Support for iPhone and AirPods Integration

description: Xiaomi has expanded the availability of its UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W to additional global markets. The slim 6mm magnetic charger features a 5,000mAh battery and supports up to 15W wireless and 22.5W wired fast charging, along with simultaneous dual-device charging. It is compatible with recent Xiaomi, Apple, Samsung and Google smartphones that support magnetic wireless charging. The lightweight accessory includes temperature control and multiple safety protections. The power bank is currently available in Australia, Singapore and Japan, with wider availability yet to be confirmed.
title: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W Launched Globally: Price, Compatibility

description: Xiaomi Watch 5 will be launched in select global markets on February 28 at 2 pm GMT (7:30 pm IST) in Barcelona, Spain. The smartwatch will be unveiled globally a day before the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 starts on March 2. The Xiaomi Watch 5 will be accompanied by the new Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi Pad 8, and Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Ultra. This comes soon after the European pricing of the smartwatch surfaced online. Xiaomi launched the Watch 5 in China in December last year with a round dial and a 1.54-inch AMOLED display.
title: Xiaomi Watch 5 Global Launch Date Announced; Set to Arrive Alongside Xiaomi 17 Series

description: The Xiaomi 17 series is all set to be launched in global markets on February 28. The  Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Xiaomi 17 Ultra Leica Edition models are expected to be released at the launch event. The  Xiaomi 17 Ultra Leica Edition is believed to arrive under a different name in the international markets. While we wait for the official confirmation, a leak has revealed that it will come with the Leica Leitzphone moniker. The live images of this Xiaomi smartphone emerged in live images on X.
title: Xiaomi's Leica Leitzphone Surfaces in Hands-on Images Ahead of Global Launch

description: The OnePlus 15R was launched in India in December, 2025, as the company’s latest performance-focused smartphone, sitting below the OnePlus 15R is the flagship lineup. The handset was introduced at a starting price tag of under Rs. 50,000 in the country, and now rivals the recently launched iQOO 15R. According to a tipster, however, the mid-flagship could soon witness a MOP (Market Operating Price) revision, beginning as early as next month.
title: OnePlus 15R Price in India Could Be Hiked in March, Tipster Claims

description: Samsung's first Galaxy Unpacked event of 2026 is right around the corner. While the company has yet to reveal the products that will be announced, the annual event is expected to witness the launch of the new generation Galaxy S series, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy S26 series. Samsung says it will showcase Galaxy AI features that make the day “easy and effortless”. The tech giant has already commenced the pre-reservations for the phones in India and the global markets.
title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked Event Today: How to Watch Galaxy S26 Series, Galaxy Buds 4 Series Launch Live
